email.subject: AI for Bond, Schoeneck & King — built for firms managing 35+ practice areas
email.body:
Hi there,

Managing 300+ attorneys across 35+ practice areas—from AI and cybersecurity to agribusiness and cannabis law—is no small feat. I imagine your teams juggle complexity that most software vendors don't understand.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for full-service law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner operations. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters: precision across diverse practices, client trust, and real efficiency gains.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding and I'd love to stop by your Syracuse office to show how—as ex-lawyers ourselves—we're helping firms like yours compete with larger competitors without the overhead.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
